title: Certified Lover Boy, Drake Spotted With Amari Bailey's Mother Johanna Leia At Dodger Stadium
htmlContent:
Drake was spotted by an ABC7 news helicopter on a private date with the mother of Sierra Canyon High School star, Amari Bailey.

Drake's next album is called Certified Lover Boy, and the name might not be more suitable. Drake was always recognized as a ladies' man and someone who still treats women like queens. Moreover, no one is safe if he sets his sights on your lady; deliver her pass and when it's more, act as if it never happened.

Recently, Internet detectives started saying that Drake was snuggling up with the mother of Sierra Canyon star Amari Bailey, Johanna Leia.

When the rumors started, there wasn't much evidence except that they were in the same building. Her son Amari plays on the team alongside Lebron's son James Bronny, and Drake still attends Bronny matches at least once a season for what it's worth.

A few days later, it was a game that caused the rumors to warm up as Drake could be seen sitting next to Johanna at the Sierra Canyon game and got them drinks at the game. How he ordered drinks at a basketball game in high school is beyond us, but it's Drake, and it's the dapper thing we expect from him.

He even had his son Adonis and Michael B Jordan as his wingman for the opportunity, an elite team that melts hearts wherever they go. Unfortunately, Sierra Canyon would continue to lose this game, and a video of Amari crying to Drake after the loss would send the Internet into a frenzy. To think of Drake as a stepfather in his own right. You can watch Drake's video giving him words of encouragement after losing below.

Later that night, Drake posted a picture of him and Amari outside having fun after the big loss showing that no matter what actually happens, Drake is in full support of the kid and is there for him during his darkest time. 

ABC7 LA had its news helicopter doing its night routine when they passed Dodger stadium and spotted only three people on the site after hours.

The news team spotted Drake sitting on third base with Johanna enjoying a private romantic dinner together in the empty stadium.

For his Artist of the Decade award, Drake leased Dodger Stadium for his family and friends, so doing this for a date shows he's not playing any games with Miss Johanna.
